checked_sources: Independent increasing-N binomial quadrature and Laplace reconstruction
correctness.rationale: Rabi evolution independently flips each spin with q(t)=a sin²(omega t); odd-N strict majority is B_N(q), so periodic Poisson integration yields exact per-cycle p_N. Unsuccessful cycles reset to same up state, and stopped-sum/renewal gives E[T_N]=1/(gamma*p_N), despite outcome-duration dependence. For a<1/2, Stirling first-success mass and geometric tail yield B_N(q)~sqrt(2/(pi*N))*sqrt(q(1-q))/(1-2q)*[4q(1-q)]^(N/2), uniformly near q=a. Nondegenerate Laplace saddle at t=P/2 adds N^-1/2, giving p_N~C(a)N^-1 exp(-N I(a)), I(a)=-1/2 log(4a(1-a)). For a_N=1/2-lambda/sqrt(N), t=P/2+y/(omega*N^1/4) gives q=1/2-(lambda+y²/2)/sqrt(N)+O(N^-1), hence central-limit integrand Phi(-2lambda-y²), dominated by e^(-c*y^4), so p_N~A(lambda)N^-1/4; direct Fubini gives F(0)=2^(1/4)Gamma(3/4)/sqrt(pi). Exact renewal transform E exp(-sT_N)=U_N(s)/(s/(gamma+s)+U_N(s)) with U_N(s)=E[e^-s tau J] gives gamma p_N T_N=>Exp(1) and variance ratio 1. Independent quadratures at fixed a=.2 and lambda=0 for increasing odd N approach both predicted prefactors. These numerical checks are not an infinite proof.
residual_risks: Finite quadratures corroborate but do not establish the uniform binomial tail or critical Hoeffding-dominated limit.

originality.rationale: The primary 2022 Rabi-reset paper already gives exact majority transition integral and qualitative exponentially long finite-size lifetime, and the 2021 framework supplies general conditional reset renewal theory; these are credited, not claimed new. The sharp exact binomial LD prefactor, quarter-power scaling function and first-switch limit are additional mathematical analyses not found in inspected primary material.
residual_risks: General exact transition integral in 2022 paper makes these asymptotics derivable; unlocated supplementary or later specialized finite-size analyses may already have them.
Strict odd-N projective common Poisson reset, ideal noninteracting qubits; fixed a or fixed lambda, not general physical noise or uniform lambda tending to infinity.
First-switch law is not a global mixing-time law.
